plan.title: Fix os.fchmod Windows incompatibility in storage.py
plan.description: Replace os.fchmod with hasattr check and fallback for Windows compatibility
tdd_sequence: 1. Create failing regression test that mocks os.fchmod to raise AttributeError
2. Run test to confirm RED phase
3. Implement minimal fix: wrap os.fchmod in try-except for AttributeError
4. Run test to confirm GREEN phase
5. Run all storage tests to ensure no regression
acceptance_criteria: save() no longer raises AttributeError on Windows when os.fchmod is unavailable
Unix platforms continue to set 0o600 permissions correctly

implementation.approach: Used contextlib.suppress(AttributeError) to wrap os.fchmod call

risks: Windows file permissions work differently - we may only be able to set read-only flag
The try-except approach is the minimal fix but doesn't set any permissions on Windows
